name: Taj Mahal
hook: A marble tomb for one wife, built by an emperor his son overthrew — the facts Jeopardy actually asks.

facts.label: Shah Jahan
facts.statement: Shah Jahan, the 17th-century Mughal emperor, built the Taj Mahal as a tomb for his favorite wife, Mumtaz Mahal.

facts.label: Agra, India
facts.statement: The Taj Mahal stands in Agra, India; Agra is southeast of New Delhi and also home to the Red Fort.

facts.label: a mausoleum
facts.statement: It is a mausoleum; Tagore called it a teardrop on the cheek of time, and it has been billed as the Eighth Wonder of the World.

facts.label: white marble and the dome
facts.statement: Built of white marble, the Taj Mahal has one large onion dome and four smaller domes.

facts.label: Aurangzeb
facts.statement: After the Taj Mahal was completed, Shah Jahan's son Aurangzeb deposed him and took over the Mughal Empire.

facts.label: Koran inscriptions
facts.statement: Parts of the Taj Mahal are inscribed with verses from the Koran.
